SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar In Use 3.3.1 Verbs and tense, part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How did you spend your last holiday? 2. Why should we use correct verbs and tenses?

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar In Use 3.3.1 Verbs and tense together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

Communication and collaboration: A learner engage in conversations in pairs using verbs in various tenses.
